chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch.46: Keke's Binding Art Shocks Xiao Chen
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen meets the true owner of the Little Sacred Tree—a tiny beast with a terrifying binding art. Can he earn its trust while plotting vengeance against Treefolk Valley?
